summary: Phase 10 frontend tested end-to-end at 390x844. Employee login + Account menu correctly shows menu-tracker and hides menu-deleted/menu-activity; direct navigation to /admin/deleted and /admin/activity as employee is blocked (403, zero rows). Tracker: view chips (completed/resolved), range chips (week/month/custom/all), tracker-prev/tracker-next shift tracker-period, invalid custom date shows 'Enter both dates as YYYY-MM-DD', tracker-search filters, tracker-sort chips cycle, tracker-count updates (51 projects on 'all'), tracker-export-csv and tracker-export-xlsx both triggered web downloads (work-tracker.csv/.xlsx) with no errors. Delete flow on API-created TEST-UI-DEL-* project: delete-sheet showed delete-ref and delete-address, backdrop tap did NOT dismiss (dismissOnBackdrop=false honoured), delete-cancel closed, delete-confirm navigated back and the ref no longer appears in dashboard project-search-input. Admin login: menu-tracker/menu-deleted/menu-activity all present; deleted page shows deleted-row-{ref} with 'Emma Employee (employee)' and date; restore-{ref} removed the row and the project reappears in dashboard search. Activity log shows entries with user name/role/ID suffix/date/record_type/reference; activity-kind-deletion filter yields 14 entries; activity-search by TEST ref returns 2 entries (Project Deleted + Project Restored); infinite scroll via mouse wheel grew list 50 -> 151. Admin direct /tracker works too. No React Native red screens or deprecated-package issues detected in the touched files.
action_items: Optional: pass full ISO date (not just picker) is handled, but consider surfacing an inline error only after a user leaves the custom-date field to avoid flicker while typing (minor UX).

Optional: Deprecation warning in logs: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' originates from a shared component (likely Sheet/overlay). Non-blocking, but could be migrated when touching those components.
critical_code_review_comments: tracker.tsx uses URLSearchParams correctly and gates query on customOk — robust.
project/[id].tsx delete sheet uses dismissOnBackdrop=false and separate error state (delErr) — good UX.
admin/deleted.tsx invalidates projects/dashboard/review-groups/tracker caches on restore — correct.
admin/activity.tsx uses useInfiniteQuery and shows actor_id.slice(-6) for ID suffix — matches spec.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only run; backend verified prior iteration)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-UI-DEL-1792473553 project via POST /api/projects as employee; it was soft-deleted and then restored by admin during the test. Project is restored (not left in Recycle Bin). Main agent may clean it up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 UI (Work Tracker, Soft Delete + Recycle Bin, Activity Log) fully functional via web preview. Use /app/tests/frontend_tracker_delete.py as a reference Playwright flow. Only TEST-* refs should be touched. Backend auth via POST /api/auth/login + Bearer access_token works for Playwright page.request. Infinite scroll on FlatList requires mouse wheel (window scrollTo does not trigger onEndReached in RN web).
